property_summary: After any successful fillOrder, c.positionExpirations at the relevant position key must equal block.timestamp + order.duration; the mutant stores the raw duration instead, so for any fill with block.timestamp > 0 the stored expiration is wrong.
change_summary: Replace the stored expiration value `block.timestamp + order.duration` with `order.duration`, so every fill writes a different (much smaller) expiration value.
